# Data Centre III

> Maintenance for the smart busway, RTOB & Replacement of the rPDUs for the full IT racks without interrupting the critical load.

## Project Overview

- Category: Advanced Technical Facilities
- Location: Dubai, UAE
- Capacity: 2.4 MW IT
